The '''Maximum Security Power Center''' was an area located in the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It contained an emergency reset to one of [[Belsavis prison]]'s [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]].
